title: Underlying twisted site with cocontinuous inclusion
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site with pullbacks, let $s:C\simeq C$ have both directions continuous, let $R$ be a commutative ring sheaf, and let $a:(s^{-1})^*R\simeq R$. Use the Site, module translation $\sigma$, and fixed-pair definitions of [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. There exists $S:\operatorname{Site}(J,s,R,a)$, consisting of the copied-object category with arrows $\coprod_{n\in\mathbb Z}\operatorname{Hom}(X,s^nY)$ and its normalized identity and composition, the degree-zero inclusion, the generated Grothendieck topology, and the coefficient sheaf with its prescribed minus-one ring map. Its inclusion is also cocontinuous.

source.place: Original twisted-site steps 1, 2, and the coefficient part of step 4. Agent variant motivated by Tag 00W0 (proposition-sheaves-on-group), not a claim that that tag proves the twisted assertion.

proof.text: Use the coherent labelled category and its inclusion and normalized hom formulas from lem-sf-twisted-action-category.
Use the generated topology, continuity, cocontinuity and restricted sheaf criterion from lem-sf-twisted-action-topology.

Take the explicit ring presheaf of lem-sf-twisted-action-coefficient. Its restriction is R, hence the topology criterion makes it a sheaf. Package the coefficient restriction and minus-one normalization with the preceding category and topology into the prescribed Site structure, and retain the cocontinuity proof.

proof_origin.place: Real construction from the existing coherent integer tensor powers, integer shift extension, and integer-action site normalization; all supporting lemmas are proved.

from.place: The parent obligation has no created.item blueprint ancestor. Its recorded provenance is lem-a1-local-boundary-duality and the evaluation/biduality sentence of thm-coef-qbar-verdier.
